summary: Pharming Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about its upcoming presentations at the CIS 2026 Annual Meeting, highlighting leniolisib pediatric data in APDS and clinical experience in CVID and related disorders. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation transaction is announced. This is a routine disclosure of scientific conference participation and clinical trial updates, not a corporate event triggering a special-situations classification.
